supported_empirical_domain.source_clocks: exactly two externally specified incommensurate clocks
supported_empirical_domain.qualified_ratio_evidence: golden-ratio branch only in current time-domain corpus
supported_empirical_domain.single-clock_integer_DTC: cross-chart control / outside this source-defined two-clock domain

chart_coordinate.role: mandatory reported chart coordinate; NOT an admission gate
chart_coordinate.reason: same-system discrimination and robustness are insufficient for hard gating

stability_clause.rule: raw M_frac must retain the raw gate under every frozen robustness transformation

physical_extension.rule: source-native collective/coupling/rigidity evidence remains separate from the temporal grammar
physical_extension.reason: Luo demonstrates necessity; Zhu/Malz do not provide a portable equivalent observable

failure_logic.OUTSIDE_CHART_DOMAIN: No legitimate externally specified two-clock torus or no genuine time-domain observable.
failure_logic.SOURCE_UNANCHORED: P_src phase-label null clause fails. Do not claim source-torus structural organization.
failure_logic.MIXED_ORGANIZATION_SPECTRAL_NULL: M_frac does not exceed the Fourier-phase null criterion.
failure_logic.MIXED_ORGANIZATION_UNSTABLE: M_frac raw gate is not retained under the frozen robustness suite.
failure_logic.TEMPORAL_CORE_SUPPORTED: D_2clk + P_src + M_frac raw + Fourier-null + stability clauses are satisfied.
failure_logic.PHYSICAL_ADMISSIBILITY_PENDING: Temporal core may be supported, but no legitimate source-native collective evidence is available.
failure_logic.PHYSICAL_EXTENSION_SUPPORTED: Temporal core plus independently justified domain-specific collective evidence; not a universal numeric verdict in v001.
